text:
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT ALERT: streaming-generator service p99 spike detected for region us-west-2 on model variant gpt-rw-7b-int8. p99=2.3s (baseline 0.45s). multiple streaming stalls reported. paging Ana (oncall).
Ana (oncall): I'm on it. seeing a jump in streaming stalls and KV cache miss ratio at the same time. correlating with last config rollout 03:12 UTC — quant-profile: int8-calib-v2 applied to canary pool.
Eve: Customer Support flag: user 'AcmeSearch' reported repeated partial streams and UI hangs. They sent HAR logs.
Ana (oncall): putting immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable int8 profile rollout for live pool 2) enable fallback-to-fp16 for streaming routes 3) throttle batching to single-request slots for tail probing. will coordinate rollback if knob flip doesn't help.
Marco: +1. how many backend nodes affected? logs show KV dequant refaults on 4 of 8 serving GPUs in pool-a.
Ana (oncall): per metrics: affected pool-a nodes: gpu-rt-12, gpu-rt-13, gpu-rt-15, gpu-rt-18. spike started at ~03:13 UTC. request mix impacted: long-context streaming calls (>2048 tokens) and chat streaming with function-calls.
Harry: tagging SLO numbers: p95 went from 120ms -> 420ms, p99 from 450ms -> 2300ms. Streaming stall count (stall>1s) increased from 2/hr -> ~160 in last 20m. customer impact: ~7 paid customers saw degraded streaming UX.
Customer Support: AcmeSearch escalated, UX freezing during live demos. They asked for ETA.
Ana (oncall): ETA for initial mitigation: 10m to flip rollout and validate. executing rollback of quant-profile on canary and stopping further canary promotion.
Deploy-Bot: Received request: rollback quant-profile int8-calib-v2 -> int8-calib-v1 for block: canary-pool. Command queued.
Marco: while rollback runs, recommend enabling route-level fallback to model:gpt-rw-7b-fp16 for streaming endpoints with >1s stall OR route policy "latency-sensitive". That will divert sensitive customers.
Ana (oncall): applying fallback policy now. command:

```
# disable new quant profile for live pool
curl -X POST $PLATFORM/api/v1/pools/cancel-rollout -d '{"pool":"pool-a","profile":"int8-calib-v2"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

Ana (oncall): also temporarily reducing max_batch to 1 for streaming worker groups:
```
# platform patch
PATCH /api/v1/workers/pool-a
{"max_batch":1}
```

Marco: Kibana query I ran to confirm KV miss spikes:
```
index=serving-* host:gpu-rt-* | where model_variant=="gpt-rw-7b-int8" and kv_miss_rate>0.05 | stats count by host
```

Eve: after the rollback flip, I see p99 dropping from 2.3s -> 0.7s on canary within 4 mins. still elevated vs baseline but much better. streaming stall counts reduced to 12 in last 10m.

Ana (oncall): good. escalate to oncall lead Marco for handoff — I'm shifting to customer comms and postmortem writeup.

Marco: taking over. next steps: 1) full rollback from int8-calib-v2 across pool-a if metrics stable in 15m 2) capture traces for stalled requests and KV dequant traces 3) run quant-calib regression on synthetic workload to reproduce 03:12 pattern 4) prepare playbook entry for "int8-calib rollout stalls".

Harry: please capture SLO breach windows for billing and alerting. I'm creating an incident ticket and costing estimate.

Customer Support: telling AcmeSearch we have a mitigation and are rolling back. sending interim note: "we have identified a config change causing intermittent streaming stalls; mitigation underway; we'll follow up with details and ETA for permanent fix." :thumbsup:

SRE-Bot: AUTO: Incident severity updated -> sev2. Notify #ops-paging and #status-updates.

Marco: Assigning owners: Ana -> customer comms + initial postmortem draft, Marco -> technical lead for rollback + repro, Eve -> monitoring dashboards + regression alerts, Harry -> SLO/accounting + external comms. tagging @security if any data-access flags.

Ana (oncall): handoff complete. I'm off primary, will remain available for questions.

Eve: rolling out dashboard widget: p95/p99 streaming by model-variant + kv_miss_rate. adding an alert: if kv_miss_rate > 0.03 and p99>1s -> page.

Marco: small note — we saw a subtle interaction: int8-calib-v2 introduced a new packing kernel that increases dequant mem pressure for long sequences, triggering async stalls on KV refill. reproducing locally with the long-context generator harness.

Harry: external impact summary draft:
- window: 03:13 - 03:37 UTC (24m)
- p95 degraded for 24m, p99 degraded peaked 03:18 UTC
- affected customers: ~7 with streaming-heavy usage (AcmeSearch highest severity)
- mitigation: rollback to int8-calib-v1 + enable fp16 fallback for latency-sensitive routes
- next actions: repro, fix packing kernel, tighter rollout guard (auto-rollback on p99 delta > 0.5s), postmortem

Customer Support: AcmeSearch confirms UI improved after rollback. thanks team.

Marco: planning a controlled re-run of int8-calib-v2 on a small synthetic-only pool with tracing enabled and KV cache warmers. do not re-promote to live until patch.

Ana (oncall): leaving final notes: please add KB article with rollback steps and the new autopilot guard. I'll link the customer-facing incident note in the ticket.

SRE-Bot: AUTO: Incident state -> mitigated. Severity -> sev3. Logging timeline to incident-archive.

Marco: closing handoff. follow-ups: reproduce, patch packing kernel, add rollout guard, update runbook. I'll own schedule for the patch and verification. If anything else pops, ping me.

Eve: noted. adding retrospective to next SRE retro.

Harry: filing postmortem signal to PMs and AE team. tagging Billing for possible SLA credits.

Ana (oncall): thanks everyone. good quick response. :heart:
